text: Right, I sent a message earlier and nobody has replied, so trying again. My son is 8 and his temperature is 38.1, I've checked it twice now with the same thermometer so I know it's right. His eye is pink and sticky, there's yellowish gunk in the lashes and I've been wiping it with cotton wool and cooled boiled water like my mum always did. I'm not after a lecture, I just want to know whether this is something I take him to the GP for in the morning or whether I need to do something tonight, because the GP line is impossible and I'm not sitting in a waiting room for four hours if I don't need to. He's got school tomorrow and I'm assuming he can't go with a sticky eye but nobody ever tells you these things. I've been sitting here with my phone for over an hour waiting so if someone could actually get back to me that would be great.
